known_facts: The Mindbloom Petal is the only known cure for 'mind-fracturing' curses.
Legend says the petal can 'restore what was taken' from a mind.
The petal is connected to the Blue Moon and is said to bloom in the Whispering Caves.
I do not know the specific harvesting technique, only that it is fragile.
The village Herbalist is the local expert on rare plants and likely knows the harvesting secret.
